blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve remarkable performance in video synthesis, but their iterative denoising process suffers from high inference latency. To address this, caching has emerged as an effective acceleration strategy by capitalizing on inter-step redundancy during denoising.
Existing dynamic caching methods typically estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step (step error) to guide cache decisions, whereas our concern is how much quality loss cache reuse would cause in the final generated video (terminal error). We show that step error does not directly correspond to terminal error and that latent information helps capture their relationship, thereby informing cache decisions. Moreover, existing threshold-based methods cannot provide precise speedup control, making it difficult to meet practical requirements for user-specified acceleration targets. To address these limitations, we introduce MORCA , a cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make latent-aware reuse/recompute decisions under user-specified acceleration targets. Extensive experiments on different video generation models across multiple target acceleration ratios demonstrate that MORCA achieves better generation fidelity than state-of-the-art caching methods under comparable computational budgets.
Code is available at https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA .
blocks.zh:
分化变形器(DiTs)在视频合成中取得了出众的性能,但他们的迭代去诺过程受到高推论延迟的困扰. 为了解决这一问题,通过在取消通知时利用跨步骤冗余,缓存已成为一项有效的加速战略。
现有的动态缓存方法通常估计缓存再利用会在每一个去诺步骤(步骤错误)中引入来指导缓存决定的错误,而我们所担心的是,在最终生成的视频中,质量损失缓存再利用将造成多少(地心错误). 我们显示步骤错误与终端错误并不直接对应,潜在信息有助于捕捉它们的关系,从而通知缓存决定. 此外,现有的以阈值为基础的方法不能提供精确的加速控制,因此难以满足用户指定加速目标的实际要求. 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了MORCA, 即通过离线到上线强化学习培训的缓存调度框架,以便在用户指定的加速目标下作出潜在意识再利用/计算决定。 跨多个目标加速率的不同视频生成模型的广泛实验表明,在可比计算预算下,MORCA比最先进的缓存方法更能实现生成忠诚.

blocks.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) combined with Flow Matching paradigms ( Lipman et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in high-fidelity visual generation ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2025 ) . Despite this progress, the multi-step iterative denoising process incurs substantial computational cost and high inference latency, particularly for video synthesis. To address this bottleneck, various acceleration approaches have emerged, including distillation, quantization, sparse attention, and caching. Among these, distillation requires additional training of the generative model, while quantization and sparse attention typically rely on specialized kernels. Caching offers a lightweight alternative with flexible speed–quality trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 分化变形器(DiTs)(Peebles and Xie, 2023)与"流相匹配"范式(Lipman等, 2023;Liu等, 2023)结合,在高真能视觉生成方面表现出了卓越的能力(Wan等, 2025;Kong等, 2025.). 尽管取得了这些进展,但多步骤迭代去诺过程需要大量的计算成本和高推论延迟性,特别是在视频合成方面. 为了解决这一瓶颈,出现了各种加速方法,包括蒸馏、量化、注意力稀少和缓存。 其中分馏需要基因模型的额外训练,而分数化和注意力稀少一般依赖于专门的内核. 缓存提供了一种轻量级的选择,具有灵活的速度-质量取舍。

blocks.en: Cache-based methods exploit inter-step redundancy by skipping the computation of the entire denoising network or selected components (typically the DiT blocks) at some denoising steps and reusing the corresponding results cached at previous steps. Early methods adopt fixed cache schedules ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025b ) (e.g., recomputing only at fixed intervals), which do not account for runtime denoising dynamics. Dynamic caching methods ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Kahatapitiya et al., 2025 ; Chung et al., 2026 ; Bu et al., 2026 ) attempt to estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step and use these estimates to make cache decisions through threshold-based rules.
blocks.zh: 基于缓存的方法利用跨步骤冗余,在一些去诺步骤上跳过整个去诺网络或所选组件(通常为DiT块)的计算,并重用之前步骤所缓存的相应结果. 早期的方法采用固定缓存时间表(马等,2024;李等,2024;赵等,2025b;刘等,2025b) (如只按固定间隔重算),不计入运行时间去诺能动态. 动态缓存方法(Liu等人,2025年a;Kahatapitiya等人,2025年;Chung等人,2026年;Bu等人,2026年)试图估计缓存再利用在每个去诺步骤上会出现的错误,并利用这些估计通过基于阈值的规则作出缓存决定.

blocks.en: However, this paradigm relies exclusively on the immediate error introduced by cache reuse ( step error ) to make decisions, whereas our concern is the quality loss in the final generated video ( terminal error ). How the former translates into the latter through subsequent denoising steps remains unclear. To investigate this relationship, we conduct a series of experiments. As shown in Fig. 1 , step error exhibits similar patterns across these prompts, while terminal error varies substantially. Quantitative results in Table 1 further show that step error alone is insufficient to accurately predict terminal error.
blocks.zh: 然而,这个范式完全依靠缓存再利用(步骤错误)带来的即时错误来作出决定,而我们所担心的是最终生成的视频的质量损失(终端错误). 前者如何通过随后的发号施令步骤转化为后者仍然不清楚。 为了调查这种关系,我们进行了一系列实验. 如图一所示,步骤错误在这些提示中显示类似的模式,而终端错误则大相径庭. 表1中的定量结果进一步表明单步出错不足以准确预测终端出错.

blocks.en: We propose that latents may contain information that helps capture how step error translates into terminal error, thus informing cache decisions. To test this idea, we train a predictor to estimate terminal error from step error. As reported in Table 1 , incorporating lightweight features extracted from the input latents at the current and previous steps (see Sec. 3.2 ) substantially improves prediction accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们提议,潜伏物可能包含有助于捕捉步骤错误如何转化为终端错误的信息,从而为缓存决定提供信息. 为了测试这个想法,我们训练一个预测器,从步法错误中估算终端错误. 如表1所报告,纳入从当前和以往步骤(见第3.2节)的输入潜出物中提取的轻度特性,大大提高了预测的准确性。

blocks.en: Motivated by this finding, we train a latent-aware scheduler to make terminal-error-guided cache decisions. We provide the scheduler with SeaCache’s proxy signal for step error (see Sec. 3.1 ) and latent features to help bridge the gap between step error and terminal error. Given the sequential nature of cache scheduling, we formulate it as a Markov decision process (MDP) and optimize the scheduler using reinforcement learning. In practical applications, users often require a specific acceleration ratio. While existing threshold-based caching methods offer only approximate speedup control through threshold adjustment, we use the observed relationship between speedup and the number of reuse steps (Fig. 3 ) to translate the target acceleration ratio into a reuse budget constraint, then reduce the resulting constrained MDP to an equivalent standard augmented MDP (Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 基于这个发现,我们训练了一个潜在意识的排程器 来做出终端 - 错误的缓存决定。 我们向调度员提供SeaCache的代理信号,用于步骤错误(见Sec. 3.1)和潜在特性,以帮助弥合步骤错误和终端错误之间的差距。 鉴于缓存调度的相继性质,我们把它制定为马可夫决定过程(MDP),并使用强化学习来优化调度器. 在实际应用中,用户经常需要特定的加速比. 虽然现有的以阈值为基础的缓存方法仅通过阈值调整提供近似快取控制,但我们利用所观察到的快取和再利用步骤数之间的关系(图3),将目标加速比转化为再利用预算限制,然后将由此产生的受约束的MDP降低为等同标准增强的MDP(Sec. 3.2)。

blocks.en: Since collecting training data requires costly inference runs, we adopt an offline-to-online reinforcement learning framework based on IQL ( Kostrikov et al., 2022 ) to train the scheduler. As an off-policy algorithm, IQL offers higher data utilization than on-policy methods. Offline training provides an effective and stable initialization from limited data, while online fine-tuning allows the scheduler to explore under its current policy and further improve performance. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose MORCA , a latent-aware cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make adaptive cache decisions under user-specified speedups. • We design a budget-constrained and latent-aware scheduler that can make terminal-error-guided cache decisions while precisely controlling the acceleration ratio. • We introduce an offline-to-online RL paradigm for scheduler optimization: the offline stage provides an effective initialization, while online fine-tuning further improves its performance. • Extensive experiments on different video generation models demonstrate that MORCA achieves better speed–quality trade-offs than state-of-the-art caching methods.
blocks.zh: 由于收集培训数据需要昂贵的推论运行,我们采用了基于IQL(Kostrikov等,2022年)的离线到线强化学习框架来培训调度员. 作为政策外算法,IQL提供的数据利用率高于政策上的方法. 离线培训提供从有限数据中有效而稳定的初始化,而在线微调则允许调度员根据其现行政策进行探索并进一步改善绩效. • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提议通过线下到线上强化学习,在用户指定的速度下作出适应性缓存决定,从而建立一个潜在意识缓存调度框架。 我们设计了一个受预算限制和潜在意识的调度器,可以作出终端-错误引导的缓存决定,同时精确控制加速率。 我们引入了离线到上线的RL模式,用于调度器优化:离线舞台提供有效的初始化,而在线微调则会进一步提高其性能. · 对不同视频生成模型的广泛实验表明,MORCA比最先进的缓存方法更能实现速度和质量取舍。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Diffusion Inference Acceleration
blocks.zh: 2.1 传播推论加速

blocks.en: Existing approaches to accelerating diffusion inference mainly include fast sampling, distillation, quantization, sparse attention, and caching. Fast samplers and numerical solvers reduce model evaluations but may sacrifice quality under aggressive step reduction ( Song et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ) . Distillation enables few-step or one-step generation but requires additional training ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024 ) . Quantization reduces the precision of weights and activations ( Shang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2025a ) , while sparse attention restricts attention computation to selected token pairs ( Xi et al., 2025 ) . Both effectively lower per-step computation but typically rely on specialized kernels to realize inference speedups.
blocks.zh: 加速传播推断的现有方法主要包括快速取样、蒸馏、量化、注意力稀少和缓存。 快速采样者和数字解析者减少模型评价,但可能会在主动减少步骤的情况下牺牲质量(Song等,2021;Liu等,2022;Lu等,2022;Lu等,2025;Zhao等,2023)。 蒸发使一代人能够少步或多步,但需要更多的培训(Salimans和Ho,2022;Song等,2023;Luo等,2023;Yin等,2024)。 量子化降低了重量和活性化的精度(Shang等,2023;Li等,2023;He等,2023;Zhao等,2025a),而注意力的稀少限制了对所选的令牌对等的注意(Xi等,2025.). 两者都有效地降低了每步计算,但一般依靠专门的内核来实现推论速度.

blocks.en: 2.2 Caching-based Diffusion Model Acceleration
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于缓冲的传播模式加速

blocks.en: Cache-based acceleration methods exploit inter-step redundancy by skipping computation in all or part of the denoising network at selected steps and reusing previously cached results. These methods can be characterized along three complementary dimensions. Caching Granularity determines what is cached and reused, including layer or DiT-block outputs ( Wimbauer et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , attention outputs ( Zhao et al., 2025b ) , CFG branch outputs ( Lyu et al., 2025 ) , and finer-grained token features ( Zou et al., 2025 ) . Cache Reuse Strategy determines how cached features are utilized, evolving from direct reuse ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ) to feature correction or approximation ( Lyu et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2026 ) , and further to explicit feature forecasting ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . Caching Schedule determines which steps reuse cached results and which recompute. Early methods typically employ fixed schedules with predefined recomputation steps ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2025b ) , which do not adapt to runtime denoising dynamics. Dynamic methods instead estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each step and apply threshold-based rules to guide cache decisions. TeaCache uses timestep-modulated input differences as a proxy for output variation, AdaCache further incorporates motion-aware information, DiCache estimates caching errors through shallow-layer probes, and SeaCache derives a spectral-evolution-aware cache signal by suppressing noise-dominated components ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Kahatapitiya et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2026 ; Chung et al., 2026 ) . Recent works have also explored learning-based cache scheduling ( Zhao et al., 2026b ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) , which we discuss and compare in detail in Sec. 2.3 .
blocks.zh: 基于缓存的加速方法通过在选定的步骤跳过全部或部分去诺网络的计算并重用先前被缓存的结果来利用跨步骤冗余. 这些方法可分为三个相辅相成的方面。 Caching Granularity决定了缓存和再利用的内容,包括分层或DiT块输出(Wimbauer等,2024;Chen等,2024;注意输出(Zhao等,2025b;CFG分支输出(Lyu等,2025;和细纹符号特征(Zou等,2025)。 缓存再利用战略确定如何利用缓存特征,从直接再利用(Ma等,2024;Zhao等,2025b)演变为特征校正或近似(Lyu等,2025;Bu等,2026),并进一步进行明确的特征预测(Liu等,2025b)。 缓存时间表确定哪些步骤的再利用缓存结果和哪些步骤的再计算。 早期方法一般采用有预定义重算步骤的固定时间表(马等,2024;李等,2024;赵等,2025b;刘等,2025b),不适应运行时间去诺能动态. 相反,动态方法估计了缓存再利用在每个步骤上将引入的错误,并应用基于阈值的规则来指导缓存决定. TeaCache使用时序调制的输入差异作为输出变异的代名词,AdaCache进一步将运动感知信息纳入其中,DiaCache通过浅层探测器估算出缓冲误差,而SeaCache通过压制以噪声为主的成分来得到光谱-革命缓冲信号(Liu等,2025a;Kahatapitiya等,2025;Bu等,2026;Chung等,2026). 近期的作品还探索了以学习为基础的缓存列表(赵等,2026b;谢等,2026;赵等,2026a),我们在第2.3章中详细讨论和比较.

blocks.en: 2.3 Reinforcement-Learning-Based Cache Scheduling
blocks.zh: 2.3 基于强化学习的缓存时间安排

blocks.en: Cache scheduling is naturally a sequential decision problem suited to reinforcement learning. RAPID 3 is the first work to formulate cache scheduling as an MDP and train a scheduler through reinforcement learning to make cache-reuse decisions at each denoising step ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) . Concurrent with our work, BAG and OnlineCache explore different approaches to learning cache schedules. BAG constructs a high-quality schedule dataset through expensive offline search and distills these schedules into a lightweight gating network for per-step decisions ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . OnlineCache uses REINFORCE to train a latent-aware scheduler, but its on-policy RL paradigm limits data reuse and training flexibility. Moreover, its reward-based speedup control cannot guarantee meeting user-specified acceleration targets ( Xie et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 缓存排程自然是一个相继决定的问题,适合强化学习. RAPID 3是第一个制定缓存调度作为MDP的工作,并通过强化学习来训练调度器,在每个去诺步骤上做出缓存-再用的决定(Zhao等,2026b.). 与我们的工作同时,BAG和OnlineCache探讨了学习缓存时间表的不同方法. BAG通过昂贵的离线搜索构建出高质量的时间表数据集,并将这些时间表提炼成一个轻量级的地标网络,以供逐步决定(Zhao等,2026a.). OnlineCache使用REINFORCE来培训一种潜在意识调度器,但其政策RL范式限制了数据再利用和培训的灵活性. 此外,其基于奖励的加速控制不能保证达到用户指定的加速目标(Xie等,2026年).

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present MORCA, an offline-to-online reinforcement learning framework for budget-constrained and latent-aware cache scheduling in video diffusion acceleration, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Building upon SeaCache (Sec. 3.1 ), MORCA retains its caching granularity and cache reuse strategy while replacing its threshold-based decision rule with a learned scheduler. In addition to SeaCache’s signals and related statistics, the scheduler incorporates latent features and reuse budget dynamics to make terminal-error-guided cache decisions under user-specified acceleration targets (Sec. 3.2 ). We optimize the scheduler through a two-stage offline-to-online IQL paradigm to achieve both high sample efficiency and strong performance (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍MORCA,这是一个线下强化学习框架,用于在视频传播加速中进行预算受限和潜在意识的缓存调度,如图所示。 2. 在SeaCache(第3.1节)的基础上,MORCA保留了它的缓存颗粒性和缓存再利用策略,同时用一个学习的排程器来取而代之的基于阈值的决定规则. 除了SeaCache的信号和相关统计之外,调度器还纳入了潜在的特征和再利用预算动态,以便在用户指定的加速目标下作出终端-error制导的缓存决定(第3.2节)。 我们通过两个阶段的离线对接IQL模式来优化调度器,以实现高样本效率和强性能(第3.3节).

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of MORCA. Bottom: A learned scheduler makes reuse/recompute decisions at each denoising step. Top left: The scheduler is budget-constrained and latent-aware. The target speedup is mapped to the required total number of reuse steps, which, together with step-error proxies and step statistics, latent features, and the current reuse count extracted from the denoising state, is fed into the scheduler for decision-making (Sec. 3.2 ). Top right: The scheduler is optimized through offline-to-online reinforcement learning using IQL (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 图2 MORCA概览. 底部 : 学习的排程器在每个去诺步骤上做出再利用/再计算决定. 左上方:排程器是预算受限和潜在意识. 目标加速被映射到所需的再利用步骤的总数上,这些步骤连同步-步代和步相统计,潜在特征,以及从去诺状态中提取的当前再利用计数,被输入排程器以供决策(第3.2条)。 右上方:调度器通过线下到线上强化学习,使用IQL(Sec.3.3.)进行优化.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: 3.3 Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning Paradigm
blocks.zh: 3.3 离线到在线强化学习范式

blocks.en: Since collecting cache-scheduling trajectories requires expensive video-generation rollouts, we adopt a two-stage offline-to-online reinforcement learning paradigm based on Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) ( Kostrikov et al., 2022 ) to achieve both high sample efficiency and strong performance. As an off-policy algorithm, IQL enables repeated reuse of collected data across optimization updates, unlike on-policy methods such as REINFORCE, which require fresh rollouts under the current policy. In the offline stage, the scheduler learns from a relatively small set of pre-collected random trajectories, providing an effective policy initialization. Starting from this initialization, online fine-tuning enables further exploration and policy improvement.
blocks.zh: 由于收集缓存定时轨迹需要昂贵的视频生成推出,我们采用了基于"隐性Q-Learning"(IQL)(Kostrikov等,2022年)的两相离线到上线强化学习范式,以实现高样本效率和强性能. 作为一种政策外算法,IQL允许在优化更新过程中重复再利用所收集的数据,这与REINFORCE等政策性方法不同,后者需要在当前政策下重新推出. 在离线阶段,调度员从一套相对较少的预收随机轨迹中学习,提供了有效的政策初始化. 从这一初始化开始,在线微调有助于进一步探索和政策改进。

blocks.en: By learning preferentially from higher-advantage actions in a relatively small dataset of randomly sampled trajectories, the offline stage provides a good initial policy without requiring prior knowledge of effective cache schedules. In contrast, starting online training from scratch may incur substantial unnecessary data collection and training costs under an initially weak policy.
blocks.zh: 离线阶段通过在随机抽取的轨迹相对较少的数据集中优先从高优势动作中学习,提供了良好的初始政策,而不需要事先了解有效的缓存时间表. 相比之下,从零开始在线培训可能会在最初政策薄弱的情况下造成大量不必要的数据收集和培训费用。

blocks.en: Starting from the offline-trained scheduler, we perform online fine-tuning as shown in Algorithm 1 (b). In each round, we collect a batch of online trajectories under randomly sampled prompts and target acceleration ratios, sampling each step’s cache decision from the current scheduler policy π φ ( ⋅ ∣ z t ) \pi_{\varphi}(\cdot\mid z_{t}) . These trajectories are added to the replay buffer alongside the offline and previously collected online data. We first perform a short critic-only warm-up with the policy fixed to adapt the Q- and V-networks to the new data, then jointly train the value functions and policy using the same IQL procedure as in offline training. Sampling trajectories from the current policy enables further exploration, while retaining the offline data in the replay buffer helps stabilize learning during fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 从离线训练的调度器开始,我们进行在线微调,如算法1(b)所示. 每轮我们收集一组在线轨迹, 以随机抽取的提示和目标加速率, 这些轨迹被加入到回放缓冲器中,与离线和之前所收集的在线数据并列. 我们首先用固定的政策进行简短的评语取暖,使Q-和V-网络适应新数据,然后使用离线训练中相同的IQL程序联合训练价值功能和政策. 从当前政策中取样出轨迹可以进一步探索,同时保留回放缓冲器中的离线数据有助于在微调时稳定学习.

blocks.en: Model configurations. We evaluate two pretrained text-to-video models from the Wan family ( Wan et al., 2025 ) : Wan2.2-T2V-A14B on NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs and Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs. Both use 50 denoising steps; other inference settings are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 模型配置. 我们评价了Wan家族的两个经过预先训练的文本到视频模型(Wan等,2025年): Wan2.2-T2V-A14B on NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU和Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU. 两者都使用50个去名步骤;附录A提供了其他推论设置。

blocks.en: Training configurations. We collect 2,500 offline trajectories from 100 prompts for Wan2.2 (25 schedules per prompt), with target speedups in [ 1.5 × , 3.5 × ] [1.5\times,3.5\times] , and 4,000 from 1,000 prompts for Wan2.1 (four schedules per prompt), with target speedups in [ 2.0 × , 4.5 × ] [2.0\times,4.5\times] . Offline IQL runs for 200 epochs with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for all networks. Online fine-tuning runs for 16 rounds, each adding 100 trajectories and performing five epochs of critic-only warm-up followed by 20 epochs of joint training, with learning rates of 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} for the policy network and 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the Q and V networks. Both stages use the AdamW optimizer and a batch size of 256. Further details are provided in Appendix B .

We compare against four representative caching-based acceleration methods: TeaCache ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , MagCache ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , DiCache ( Bu et al., 2026 ) , and SeaCache ( Chung et al., 2026 ) . For Wan2.2, only MagCache has an official implementation; we port the others from Wan2.1 with model-specific adaptations. We use their official Wan2.1 implementations directly. blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. We sample 200 prompts from VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) as a fixed evaluation set and measure visual quality using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS against no-cache references generated with the same prompts and random seeds. We report inference latency. We compare methods at approximately 1.8 × 1.8\times , 2.4 × 2.4\times , and 3.0 × 3.0\times speedup for Wan2.2, and 2.4 × 2.4\times , 3.0 × 3.0\times , and 4.0 × 4.0\times for Wan2.1. We use lower target speedups for Wan2.2 to preserve generation fidelity, as it is more sensitive to cache reuse.

blocks.en: Table 2 compares MORCA with existing caching methods at comparable speedups. Since MORCA builds on SeaCache by replacing its threshold-based scheduling with a learned scheduler, we focus on this comparison to demonstrate the effectiveness of our learned scheduling policy. On Wan2.2, MORCA achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS at all three target speedups, with PSNR gains over SeaCache of 2.22, 1.86, and 1.78 dB at 1.8 × 1.8\times , 2.4 × 2.4\times , and 3.0 × 3.0\times , respectively. On Wan2.1, it achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM at all three targets, improving PSNR over SeaCache by 1.05, 2.17, and 1.11 dB at 2.4 × 2.4\times , 3.0 × 3.0\times , and 4.0 × 4.0\times , respectively. LPIPS also improves over this baseline at all three settings and is best among all methods at 3.0 × 3.0\times and 4.0 × 4.0\times . Wan2.2 generally exhibits lower fidelity than Wan2.1 at comparable speedups, suggesting greater sensitivity to cache reuse (Sec. 4.3 ).

blocks.en: Fig. 4 presents visual comparisons with existing caching methods. As shown, MORCA better preserves the original structure while retaining fine details, as highlighted in the boxed regions. Compared with other methods, MORCA is notably better at preserving the original structure.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented MORCA, a cache scheduling framework for accelerating video diffusion models. Motivated by the gap between step error and terminal error that existing methods do not adequately address, along with their limited control over acceleration ratios, we formulated cache scheduling as an MDP, designed a budget-constrained and latent-aware scheduler for terminal-error-guided decisions under user-specified acceleration targets, and optimized it through offline-to-online IQL training. Extensive experiments on different video generation models demonstrate that MORCA achieves better speed–quality trade-offs than state-of-the-art caching methods. As a schedule-level approach, MORCA can potentially be combined with different caching granularities and cache reuse strategies for further gains. Exploring these combinations is a promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了MORCA,一个用于加速视频传播模型的缓存调度框架. 由于台阶出错和终端出错之间的差距,即现有方法无法充分解决,加上对加速率的控制有限,我们制定了缓存调度方案,作为MDP,在用户指定的加速目标下设计了预算限制和潜在意识的终端-error制导决策调度器,并通过离线对接IQL培训加以优化。 对不同视频生成模型的广泛实验表明,MORCA比最先进的缓存方法实现更好的速度-质量取舍. 作为一种时间表级方法,MORCA有可能与不同的缓存颗粒和缓存再利用策略相结合,以进一步收益. 探索这些组合是未来工作的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en: A straightforward way to generate random cache schedules is to independently sample a reuse/recompute decision at each denoising step. However, this is likely to produce trajectories with limited learning value, wasting costly generation rollouts. Instead, we adopt a more stable approach by randomizing at the threshold level: we sample a smooth threshold curve that varies across the N N denoising steps, replace SeaCache’s fixed threshold with this curve, and run inference to collect the resulting denoising trajectory.
blocks.zh: 产生随机缓存时间表的一个直接方式是在每一个去诺步骤中独立地取样一次再利用/计算决定. 然而,这很可能会产生学习价值有限的轨迹,浪费昂贵的一代推出。 相反,我们采取了一种更稳定的方法,在阈值水平上随机化:我们抽取一个平滑的阈值曲线,该曲线在N调值步骤上有所不同,用这个曲线取代了SeaCache的固定阈值,并进行推论来收集由此产生的调值轨迹。

blocks.en: To generate a random threshold curve, we control three aspects: its mean level, amplitude, and shape. The mean level is determined by mapping a sampled target acceleration ratio ρ ⋆ {\rho^{\star}} to a threshold center μ = g ⁡ ( ρ ⋆ ) \mu=g({\rho^{\star}}) through calibration. A randomly sampled amplitude factor determines the magnitude of threshold variations. To generate the shape, we randomly select a few reference steps from the N N denoising steps, sample random relative threshold values at these steps, and apply cubic smoothstep interpolation across all steps. These three factors jointly determine the threshold curve, followed by adjustments to satisfy the required bounds and smoothness constraints.
blocks.zh: 为了产生随机阈值曲线,我们控制了三个方面:其平均水平、振幅和形状。 平均水平的确定是通过校正来绘制一个被抽样的目标加速比 ^ ~ rho^{\star}} → 到一个阈值中心 μ = g → (ρ)\ mu= ({\ star}}). 一个随机抽样的振幅因子决定了阈值变化的大小. 为了生成形状,我们从N N 解析步骤中随机选择几个参考步骤,在这些步骤中抽取随机相对阈值,并在所有步骤中应用立方平滑步插法. 这三种因素共同决定了阈值曲线,再作调整以达到所要求的界限和平滑性限制.

blocks.en: After each rollout, we convert the trajectory into N N transition tuples. blocks.en: We identify two types of forced actions: (1) actions imposed by the exact reuse-budget constraint, when only one action remains feasible; and (2) mandatory recomputation at the first denoising step and the last denoising step, as well as the high-noise/low-noise expert-switching step in Wan2.2. Since these actions are determined by action restrictions rather than policy choices, we exclude the corresponding transitions from the policy loss while retaining them for the standard Q- and V-function updates.
blocks.zh: 我们确定了两种类型的强迫行动:(1) 确切的再利用预算限制所规定的行动,当时只有一个行动仍然可行;(2) 在第一个解密步骤和最后一个解密步骤以及Wan2.2的高噪声/低噪声专家抽取步骤上强制重算。 由于这些行动是由行动限制而不是政策选择决定的,我们排除了政策损失的相应过渡,而将其保留用于标准的Q-和V功能更新.

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations

blocks.en: Due to differences in denoising dynamics across models, MORCA’s learned scheduler cannot be directly transferred between models and requires separate training for each model. This introduces additional costs for collecting cache-scheduling trajectories and optimizing the scheduler. These costs may limit its practical adoption when training resources are constrained.
blocks.zh: 由于不同模型的发音动态不同,MORCA所学的调度器不能在模型之间直接转移,需要对每个模型进行单独培训. 这为收集缓存时间表和优化排程器带来了额外费用。 这些费用可能会限制在培训资源有限时实际采用。
